append.detail: Built 2026-11-10: lib/hunts/staff-proof.ts is the proof core. issueChallenge makes an HMAC-signed, expiring token bound to one Hunt, placement, venue Space and run; verifyStaffProof refuses malformed, bad signature, expired or not-yet-valid, wrong scope, staff of another Space, a paused placement and a replay (the injected consumeNonce resolves true once per nonce), and never burns the nonce on a refusal so a corrected retry still works. lib/hunts/staff-proof.test.ts covers each. The rest of the original ask (nonce table, staff scan route and screen, audited override, support appeal, held-claim review that resumes once) moved to FH-020S.
